note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (second 'purple' Kok cabinet of PvdA, VVD and D66 during an economic boom), not measured data. Influence reflects the consensual 'polder model': employers and unions bargain together with the government, a large trading and financial sector, churches with declining but still organised weight (Christian parties and schools), a small professional military, and an influential farming sector.

interest_groups.note: Multinationals, ports and banks; content with a coalition including the liberal VVD (gameplay estimate).
Union federations bargain with employers and government under the polder model.
Protestant and Catholic churches; the CDA was in opposition to the Kok cabinets.
Immigrant communities (Turkish, Moroccan, Surinamese, Antillean) and the Frisian minority.
